6f80c05d-d766-4cce-bfd1-c5e43abcc21d/Eve.cn: 也不知看了多久，<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>只觉浑身内息澎湃，头上热气直冒，<NL>心中说不出的畅快惬意，仿佛身在云端，冯虚御风，<NL><NL>成百上千种武学功法在脑海中不停闪现，<NL>无论什么奇巧兵器，妙式怪招，似都已运用娴熟，随时可以施展……

719b59b3-2816-4c47-a7ff-287162078c10/Eve.en: "The Taiwu Inheritance has not ended to this day, it is something to celebrate..."<NL><NL>Just then,<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> suddenly hears loud laughter.<NL>Turning to look, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderSubject/> fins beside <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderObject/> is only emptiness, not a single figure in sight,<NL>and when <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderSubject/> looks at the martial artist, the person still standing in place, lips slightly trembling, as if speaking...
719b59b3-2816-4c47-a7ff-287162078c10/Eve.cn: “太吾传承至今未绝，可喜可贺……”<NL><NL>就在这时，<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>忽然听到有人放声大笑， <NL>转头四顾，身侧却是一片空荡，半个人影也无，<NL>再看那练功之人，仍然侧身站在原地，嘴唇微微颤动，似在说话……

b1ea25da-6d92-459e-aeb6-4710f71b80ca/Eve.en: "You have inherited these martial arts techniques,<NL>proving that our flame lives on, to resist evil forces.<NL>I hope you can defeat them and make up for past regrets..."<NL><NL>Still in a daze, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> sees the person's form shakes and vanishes without a trace...
b1ea25da-6d92-459e-aeb6-4710f71b80ca/Eve.cn: “你已继承回这一身功法，<NL>足证我辈薪火，可以抵御邪祟，<NL>但愿你能克敌制胜，与妖魔一决高下，弥补昔时遗憾……”<NL><NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>还在发怔，<NL>那人已然身形一晃，消失无踪……
b1ea25da-6d92-459e-aeb6-4710f71b80ca/Eve.ru: "Ты унаследовал эти приемы Боевых искусств,<NL>доказывая, что наше пламя продолжает жить, чтобы противостоять силам зла.<NL>Я надеюсь, ты сможешь победить их и загладить прошлые сожаления..."<NL><NL>Все еще в Оцепенении, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> видит, как фигура человека дрожит и исчезает без следа...

a60033c5-ad3f-40fe-9d4c-69fd98f41549/Eve.en: It seems the person knew <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> was watching,<NL>and the person waited until <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> has fully absorbed the techniques before stopping and leaving,<NL>intentions are clear...
a60033c5-ad3f-40fe-9d4c-69fd98f41549/Eve.cn: 看来<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>旁观练武，早为对方知晓，<NL>那人却耐心等到<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>体悟完全，方才停手离开，<NL>其用心良苦，可见一斑……
a60033c5-ad3f-40fe-9d4c-69fd98f41549/Eve.ru: Похоже, этот человек знал <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> наблюдал,<NL>и человек ждал, пока <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> полностью усвоил техники, прежде чем остановиться и уйти,<NL>намерения ясны...

a60033c5-ad3f-40fe-9d4c-69fd98f41549/Opt.en: I'll do my best. I hope to meet your expectations...
a60033c5-ad3f-40fe-9d4c-69fd98f41549/Opt.ru: Я сделаю все, что в моих силах. Я надеюсь оправдать ваши ожидания...

53ef0b16-0738-4b0b-9a55-41beea81d76a/Eve.en: Today, I met this expert by chance,<NL>and receiving this gift is truly a great opportunity, I will cherish it well...
53ef0b16-0738-4b0b-9a55-41beea81d76a/Eve.cn: 今日偶逢高人，得此造化，<NL>实属莫大机缘，定要好好珍惜……
53ef0b16-0738-4b0b-9a55-41beea81d76a/Eve.ru: Сегодня я случайно познакомился с этим экспертом,<NL>и получение этого подарка - действительно прекрасная возможность, я буду ею дорожить...

53ef0b16-0738-4b0b-9a55-41beea81d76a/Opt.en: I hope I can stay true to my heart and not stray from my path...
53ef0b16-0738-4b0b-9a55-41beea81d76a/Opt.cn: 但愿我能坚定信念，不违本心……
53ef0b16-0738-4b0b-9a55-41beea81d76a/Opt.ru: Я надеюсь, что смогу остаться верным своему сердцу и не сбиться со своего пути...

45518b8f-cfd0-4e1f-8cd1-e3b0aeda30b4/Eve.en: Focusing on <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>'s breath, thinking about the techniques,<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderSubject/> doesn't realize that this action,<NL>is like a kettle about to boil, with Inner Breath bursting out,<NL>but the kettle is sealed like a stone cell, no way for the energy to release,<NL>causing a blockage in my meridians, and I feel a painful numbness, almost reaching the point of losing control...
45518b8f-cfd0-4e1f-8cd1-e3b0aeda30b4/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>只顾屏气凝神，思索运功，<NL>岂知这样行为，<NL>有如一壶水即将沸腾，浑身热力往外迸发，<NL>水壶却闭塞如坚石牢狱，通体竟无一个散气孔洞，<NL>内息流转不畅，自然淤堵经脉间，全身麻痹难受，险些要走火入魔……

45518b8f-cfd0-4e1f-8cd1-e3b0aeda30b4/Opt.en: (This is bad, I was careless, and now my Inner Breath is in chaos...)
45518b8f-cfd0-4e1f-8cd1-e3b0aeda30b4/Opt.cn: （不好，我一时大意，竟至内息紊乱……）
45518b8f-cfd0-4e1f-8cd1-e3b0aeda30b4/Opt.ru: (Это плохо, я был неосторожен, и теперь мое Внутреннее дыхание в хаосе...)

625f8512-744a-425a-b6fe-299e22ed8d2d/Eve.en: Fortunately, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> notices it in time, and can still recover.<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderSubject/> grit <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderPossessive/> teeth and adjust <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderPossessive/> breath, realigning <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderPossessive/> meridians, not knowing how long it takes,<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderSubject/> feel my inner breath surging again, heat rising from <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderPossessive/> head,<NL>and an indescribable sense of satisfaction, as if <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderSubject/> is floating in the clouds, riding the wind.<NL><NL>Hundreds of martial arts techniques flashing through <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderPossessive/> mind,<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderSubject/> feels like <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderSubject/> can use any weapon or unique move, easily and proficiently, ready to deploy at any moment...
625f8512-744a-425a-b6fe-299e22ed8d2d/Eve.cn: 所幸<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>察觉尚早，还可补救，<NL>当下咬牙调息，重理经脉，也不知多了多久，<NL>只觉浑身内息澎湃，头上热气直冒，<NL>心中说不出的畅快惬意，仿佛身在云端，冯虚御风，<NL><NL>成百上千种武学功法在脑海中不停闪现，<NL>无论什么奇巧兵器，妙式怪招，似都已运用娴熟，随时可以施展……

fb38994d-4e16-44c9-8128-0147a300086c/Eve.en: With concerns in <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>'s heart,<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderSubject/> even though the opportunity is rare and it would be a pity to miss it, I can only suppress my reluctance and leave quickly...
fb38994d-4e16-44c9-8128-0147a300086c/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>心有顾虑，<NL>纵然机缘难得，错过可惜，也只能按捺不舍，快步离开……
fb38994d-4e16-44c9-8128-0147a300086c/Eve.ru: С озабоченностями в <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>чье-то сердце,<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderSubject/> несмотря на то, что такая возможность выпадает редко и было бы жаль ее упустить, я могу только подавить свое нежелание и быстро уйти...

fb38994d-4e16-44c9-8128-0147a300086c/Opt.en: (Yield and offer tribute to avoid trouble...)
fb38994d-4e16-44c9-8128-0147a300086c/Opt.ru: (Уступайте и предлагайте дань уважения, чтобы избежать неприятностей...)

14b51e69-9c72-4238-aa50-1ef0bdefb115/Eve.en: "Rebuilding the 'Taiwu Ancestral Temple' still requires many hands and materials..."<NL><NL>Standing before the ruins of the Ancestral Temple, deep in thought,<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> suddenly hears a sound of bells from behind, as if a dozen horses are slowly approaching,<NL>turning around, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderSubject/> sees a group of travelers, with bulging bags on their horses, and their riders covered in dust...
14b51e69-9c72-4238-aa50-1ef0bdefb115/Eve.cn: “重建「太吾氏祠堂」，尚需不少人手、材料……”<NL><NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>立在祠堂废墟前，不停思索，<NL>忽听得身后传来一阵銮铃声响，似有十余匹马徐徐行来，<NL>回头看去，原是一支旅人队伍，马背上褡裢鼓鼓囊囊，骑者面有风尘……

14b51e69-9c72-4238-aa50-1ef0bdefb115/Opt.en: (Maybe they're people coming to seek refuge?)
14b51e69-9c72-4238-aa50-1ef0bdefb115/Opt.ru: (Может быть, это люди, пришедшие искать убежища?)

b85d894b-15cb-4715-9937-2a0a9048c940/Eve.en: In an instant,<NL>the group arrives in front of <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>,<NL>and the leader, sitting firmly on their horse, greets <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> with a bow, and then asks about the nearest town's roads...
b85d894b-15cb-4715-9937-2a0a9048c940/Eve.cn: 转瞬之间，<NL>那支队伍已行至<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>面前，<NL>首领端坐马上，向<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>拱手问好，又请教临近城镇通路……
b85d894b-15cb-4715-9937-2a0a9048c940/Eve.ru: В одно мгновение,<NL>группа прибывает перед <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>,<NL>и предводитель, твердо сидящий на своем коне, приветствует <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> с поклоном, а затем спрашивает о дорогах ближайшего города...

b85d894b-15cb-4715-9937-2a0a9048c940/Opt.en: (From their speech and manner, they don't seem like bad people...)
b85d894b-15cb-4715-9937-2a0a9048c940/Opt.ru: (Судя по их речи и манерам, они не кажутся плохими людьми...)

1e6abab0-935b-420c-a559-3417acd2e19d/Eve.en: After some pleasantries, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> has learned,<NL>that their homeland was attacked by Xiangshu Underlings, suffering greatly,<NL>and they were forced to abandon their homes, band together, and leave, now wandering without a fixed home...
1e6abab0-935b-420c-a559-3417acd2e19d/Eve.cn: 一番寒暄后，<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>得知，<NL>众人因家乡遭受相枢爪牙袭扰，痛苦不堪，<NL>不得已抛弃居所，结队离巢，而今四海为家，漂泊无定……
1e6abab0-935b-420c-a559-3417acd2e19d/Eve.ru: После нескольких любезностей, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> научился,<NL>что их родина подверглась нападению подчиненных Сяншу, сильно пострадав,<NL>и они были вынуждены покинуть свои дома, объединиться и уехать, теперь скитаясь без определенного места жительства...

1e6abab0-935b-420c-a559-3417acd2e19d/Opt.en: If you all are willing, you can stay long-term in Taiwu Village...
1e6abab0-935b-420c-a559-3417acd2e19d/Opt.cn: 若你们愿意，自可长久留在太吾村……
1e6abab0-935b-420c-a559-3417acd2e19d/Opt.ru: Если вы все захотите, вы можете остаться на длительный срок в Деревне Тайу...

be3f91e6-9286-4dce-85ac-39d0312a95da/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> introduces <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderObject/>self, reassuring them not to worry,<NL>that although Taiwu Village currently lacks housing, the land is vast, and even ten more groups like theirs could find shelter...<NL><NL>But the leader seems embarrassed, shaking head repeatedly:<NL>"We deeply appreciate your kind offer, but...<NL>heh, it's just that... Taiwu Village... we have many ties here..."
be3f91e6-9286-4dce-85ac-39d0312a95da/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>言明身份，又请众人不必担忧，<NL>当前太吾村屋舍尚少，但土地甚广，再来十支队伍，也能住下……<NL><NL>不想首领听罢，却是面有难色，连连摆手：<NL>“阁下的盛情好意，我们实在感激……只不过……<NL>嘿，只不过这太吾村……我们心中还有许多牵挂……”

be3f91e6-9286-4dce-85ac-39d0312a95da/Opt.en: (From their tone, it seems they are reluctant to settle here... oh well, everyone has their own ambitions...)
be3f91e6-9286-4dce-85ac-39d0312a95da/Opt.cn: （听其言下之意，似不愿就此退隐……也罢，人各有志……）
be3f91e6-9286-4dce-85ac-39d0312a95da/Opt.ru: (Судя по их тону, они неохотно селятся здесь... ну что ж, у каждого свои амбиции...)

7ab685d7-5480-4ddb-8872-730b8bd138c3/Eve.en: With this,<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> decides to take <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderPossessive/> leave,<NL>but unexpectedly, as I glance up, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderSubject/> catches a glimpse of a wooden tool sticking out of the leader's bag,<NL>and upon closer inspection, it's a carpenter's square!. Looking at the other bags, they contain chisels, bowsaws, hammers, and rulers,<NL>my heart stirs, and I can't help but ask again...
7ab685d7-5480-4ddb-8872-730b8bd138c3/Eve.cn: 话已至此，<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>本欲与众人行礼作别，<NL>岂知不经意间一抬眼，瞥见首领的马背褡裢中露出木器一角，<NL><NL>仔细看去，却是一方墨斗！<NL>再看其他人的褡裢中，还装着凿子、弓锯、铁锤、角尺等物，<NL>心中一动，不禁再度发问……

7ab685d7-5480-4ddb-8872-730b8bd138c3/Opt.cn: 莫非诸位都是土木匠人么？

e8a6b38a-c78e-431b-96ed-23a80a805414/Eve.en: The leader nods, saying:<NL>"We're old hands who rely on our craft to make a living, we won't starve wherever we go,<NL>and what we're best at is smithing, carpentry, and repairing buildings..."<NL><NL>As he talks about his craft, the leader speaks passionately, a smile returning to his face,<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> is eager to discuss the key points of rebuilding the 'Taiwu Ancestral Temple,' hoping the person'll speak as much as possible...
e8a6b38a-c78e-431b-96ed-23a80a805414/Eve.cn: 首领点头道：<NL>“我们这帮老伙计，一向凭手艺吃饭，走到哪里也饿不死，<NL>要说最擅长的，莫过于锻造、木工、修葺建筑……”<NL><NL>谈及本事活计，首领滔滔不绝，面上也重现笑容，<NL>而<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>有心请教重建「太吾氏祠堂」的要点，<NL>自然希望对方说得越多越好……

e8a6b38a-c78e-431b-96ed-23a80a805414/Opt.en: I didn't realize woodworking has so many aspects...
e8a6b38a-c78e-431b-96ed-23a80a805414/Opt.cn: 原来土木一行，竟有如此多的门道……
e8a6b38a-c78e-431b-96ed-23a80a805414/Opt.ru: Я и не подозревал, что деревообработка имеет так много аспектов...

ac0ba3ad-bed3-43d1-8ff6-51decccdd40f/Eve.en: "...If you trust us,<NL>just treat us to a meal, and after one night's work,<NL>not only will we handle the ruins in front of us, but everything you wish to build within a dozen lis—houses, venues, buildings—<NL>can be completed, and we'll make Taiwu Village look completely new!"<NL><NL>The leader says excitedly, clapping and laughing,<NL>but <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> is both shocked and confused!
ac0ba3ad-bed3-43d1-8ff6-51decccdd40f/Eve.cn: “……阁下若信得过我们，<NL>只需犒劳一顿饭食，花费一夜工夫，<NL>休说面前这片废墟，便是方圆数十里内，一切想要修建的屋舍、场所、楼坊……<NL>都可处理完全，定教太吾村风貌焕然一新！”<NL><NL>首领说到高兴处，忍不住拍手大笑，<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>却是又惊又疑！

ac0ba3ad-bed3-43d1-8ff6-51decccdd40f/Opt.en: Such a large project can be completed with just a meal and one night's work?!
ac0ba3ad-bed3-43d1-8ff6-51decccdd40f/Opt.cn: 如此庞大工程，竟只需一顿饭食、一夜工夫？！
ac0ba3ad-bed3-43d1-8ff6-51decccdd40f/Opt.ru: Такой большой проект можно завершить всего за один прием пищи и одну ночь работы?!

7a232026-8ee2-4397-8380-4a48bc702c12/Eve.en: Recalling the 'Taiwu Ancestral Temple' <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> saw in <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderPossessive/> dream,<NL>along with the other buildings in the village at the time,<NL>even if I commanded the villagers to work together,<NL>it would take more than one night to complete all the plans,<NL>but if I ask these craftsmen for help, it might save a lot of trouble,<NL>after all, they only ask for "one meal and one night's work,"<NL>and even if they fail, it won't harm anyone...
7a232026-8ee2-4397-8380-4a48bc702c12/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>回忆“梦中所见”的那座「太吾氏祠堂」，<NL>还有当时村中的诸多建筑，<NL>便是号令村民齐力合建，莫说一夜工夫，<NL>就算给足十夜工夫，百夜工夫，也难以一次实现所有规划，<NL><NL>可若请这队工匠相助，或许真能省去不少麻烦，<NL>毕竟他们所求花费，只是“一顿饭食，一夜工夫”，<NL>即便失败，于己于人也无甚害处……

7a232026-8ee2-4397-8380-4a48bc702c12/Opt.en: (Delegate the task of construction to the leader, describing the 'Taiwu Village' industry layout from my dream...)
7a232026-8ee2-4397-8380-4a48bc702c12/Opt.cn: （委托首领建设，向其描述“梦中所见”的太吾村产业规划图……）
7a232026-8ee2-4397-8380-4a48bc702c12/Opt.ru: (Делегируйте задачу строительства руководителю, описывая промышленный макет "Деревни Тайу" из моего сна...)

7a232026-8ee2-4397-8380-4a48bc702c12/Opt.en: (It's better to plan and build it myself, taking my time...)
7a232026-8ee2-4397-8380-4a48bc702c12/Opt.cn: （不必劳烦他人，自己动手规划，慢慢搭建……）
7a232026-8ee2-4397-8380-4a48bc702c12/Opt.ru: (Лучше спланировать и построить это самому, не торопясь...)

37a5118d-7bb9-40c0-ac32-305b9082c49d/Eve.en: This group of craftsmen appeared suddenly and mysteriously.<NL>If <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderSubject/> misses this opportunity today, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderSubject/> doesn't know when they'll see each other again...<NL><NL>How should <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> decide?
37a5118d-7bb9-40c0-ac32-305b9082c49d/Eve.cn: 这队工匠来得突然，行踪莫测，<NL>今日若错过机缘，自此一别后，也不知何时才会再见……<NL><NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>该如何抉择？
37a5118d-7bb9-40c0-ac32-305b9082c49d/Eve.ru: Эта группа мастеров появилась внезапно и таинственно.<NL>Если <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderSubject/> упускает эту возможность сегодня, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderSubject/> не знает, когда они снова увидят друг друга...<NL><NL>Как следует <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> решать?

37a5118d-7bb9-40c0-ac32-305b9082c49d/Opt.en: (I've made up my mind, no need for changes...)
37a5118d-7bb9-40c0-ac32-305b9082c49d/Opt.ru: (Я принял решение, в изменениях нет необходимости...)

37a5118d-7bb9-40c0-ac32-305b9082c49d/Opt.en: (This matter is unusual, perhaps I should think it over again...)
37a5118d-7bb9-40c0-ac32-305b9082c49d/Opt.cn: （此事非同寻常，不如再好好想想……）
37a5118d-7bb9-40c0-ac32-305b9082c49d/Opt.ru: (Этот вопрос необычен, возможно, мне следует обдумать его еще раз...)

65f421da-9b21-495c-8395-767e31bcfb4b/Eve.en: As the head of Taiwu Village, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> has <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderPossessive/> own plans for the village's construction,<NL>so he thanks the leader for their offer, and stop the conversation, watching the group leave Taiwu Village...
65f421da-9b21-495c-8395-767e31bcfb4b/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>身为太吾村之主，<NL>对于太吾村的修建规划，自有主张，<NL>当下谢过工匠首领一番好意，止住话头，目送队伍离开太吾村……
65f421da-9b21-495c-8395-767e31bcfb4b/Eve.ru: Как глава Деревни Тайу, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> имеет <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderPossessive/> собственные планы по строительству деревни,<NL>поэтому он благодарит лидера за их предложение и прекращает разговор, наблюдая, как группа покидает Деревню Тайу...

65f421da-9b21-495c-8395-767e31bcfb4b/Opt.en: (Thanks to this conversation, the 'Taiwu Ancestral Temple' will be restored...)
65f421da-9b21-495c-8395-767e31bcfb4b/Opt.cn: （得益于此次交谈，「太吾氏祠堂」定能重修如初……）
65f421da-9b21-495c-8395-767e31bcfb4b/Opt.ru: (Благодаря этому разговору "Храм предков Тайу" будет восстановлен...)

98fa7009-8e9c-46da-8c17-aab43f9d3747/Eve.en: The leader quickly draws a rough sketch,<NL>based on <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>'s description,<NL>organizing the group's work with confidence,<NL><NL>and the villagers of Taiwu, upon hearing this, react differently,<NL>some have helped in the past, some are watching, some are commenting, and some are amazed...
98fa7009-8e9c-46da-8c17-aab43f9d3747/Eve.cn: 首领依据<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>所述，<NL>迅速画出草图，指挥队伍分工协作，<NL>俨然是一副胸有成竹的模样，<NL><NL>太吾村民闻听此事，神色各异，<NL>过去帮忙者有之，在旁围观者有之，指指点点者有之，啧啧称奇者亦有之……

98fa7009-8e9c-46da-8c17-aab43f9d3747/Opt.en: (Looking at the craftsmen working hard, there's nothing strange about it...)
98fa7009-8e9c-46da-8c17-aab43f9d3747/Opt.cn: （看众工匠劳作奔忙，并无什么奇异之处……）
98fa7009-8e9c-46da-8c17-aab43f9d3747/Opt.ru: (Глядя на усердно работающих мастеров, в этом нет ничего странного...)

32136431-c87f-44fd-b2af-94d0a70d3f30/Eve.en: As night falls,<NL>all the villagers return home to rest, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> do, too,<NL>but in my sleep, I can still hear the sound of tools clanging outside the window...
32136431-c87f-44fd-b2af-94d0a70d3f30/Eve.cn: 临到入夜，<NL>村民尽数归家休息，<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>亦然，<NL>睡梦中仿佛还能听到窗外工具声叮当作响……
32136431-c87f-44fd-b2af-94d0a70d3f30/Eve.ru: С наступлением ночи,<NL>все жители деревни возвращаются домой отдыхать, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> делай тоже,<NL>но во сне я все еще слышу лязг инструментов за окном...

32136431-c87f-44fd-b2af-94d0a70d3f30/Opt.en: After the night passes, we'll know the outcome...
32136431-c87f-44fd-b2af-94d0a70d3f30/Opt.ru: После того, как пройдет ночь, мы узнаем результат...

bdff49a7-def4-4d3a-84c4-29bdc13b1352/Eve.en: When <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> wakes up the next morning,<NL>it is already dawn, and when <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderSubject/> looks out the window, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderSubject/> is stunned!<NL><NL>All kinds of buildings have sprung up like mushrooms after rain, occupying large areas of land,<NL>the sizes and styles identical to those <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderSubject/> saw in <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderPossessive/> dream, and many villagers are gathered around, discussing the change...
bdff49a7-def4-4d3a-84c4-29bdc13b1352/Eve.cn: 待<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>再次醒来，<NL>已然天光大亮，转头向窗外一看，不禁怔住！<NL><NL>但见各式建筑有如雨后春笋，一夜之间占据大片土地，<NL>大小样式皆与“梦中所见”一般无二，更有众多村民驻足观望，议论纷纷……

bdff49a7-def4-4d3a-84c4-29bdc13b1352/Opt.en: I've woken up, but it feels as though I'm still dreaming...
bdff49a7-def4-4d3a-84c4-29bdc13b1352/Opt.cn: 我虽然醒了，却好似仍在梦中……
bdff49a7-def4-4d3a-84c4-29bdc13b1352/Opt.ru: Я проснулся, но мне кажется, что я все еще сплю...

d9844cbc-353b-4319-9246-28aad17fb49c/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> wants to thank the craftsmen,<NL>but after searching all around, there is no sign of the group,<NL>when he asked the villagers, no one knows when they finished or left...
d9844cbc-353b-4319-9246-28aad17fb49c/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>想向那一队工匠道谢，<NL>然而四下寻遍，丝毫不得队伍踪迹，<NL>再问村民，更无一人知晓他们是何时完工，何时离去……
d9844cbc-353b-4319-9246-28aad17fb49c/Eve.ru: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> хочет поблагодарить мастеров,<NL>но после того, как мы обыскали все вокруг, не нашли никаких следов группы,<NL>когда он спросил жителей деревни, никто не знает, когда они закончили или ушли...

d9844cbc-353b-4319-9246-28aad17fb49c/Opt.en: It seems I've truly encountered an extraordinary group today...
d9844cbc-353b-4319-9246-28aad17fb49c/Opt.cn: 传说江湖中能人异士甚多，今日算是见着了……
d9844cbc-353b-4319-9246-28aad17fb49c/Opt.ru: Похоже, сегодня я действительно столкнулся с необычной группой...

a858f2f2-3fcb-466e-ba6e-94fc9188f565/Eve.en: "The world is treacherous, and everything brings ill-omens. Then, there is also [Xiangshu]</color> lurking in the dark.<NL>I am but a greenhorn starting out in the world. I wonder when I will find my 'Foster Father,' and what about my future..."
a858f2f2-3fcb-466e-ba6e-94fc9188f565/Eve.cn: “江湖险恶，万事皆凶，更有「相枢」伏于暗中，<NL>我初出茅庐，也不知何时才能寻到‘义父’，这未来……”
a858f2f2-3fcb-466e-ba6e-94fc9188f565/Eve.ru: - Мир коварен, и все приносит дурные предзнаменования. Кроме того, есть еще [Сяншу]</color> прячущийся в темноте.<NL>Я всего лишь новичок, начинающий свой путь в этом мире. Интересно, когда я найду своего "Приемного отца" и что будет с моим будущим..."

a858f2f2-3fcb-466e-ba6e-94fc9188f565/Opt.en: ...all I seek is to not besmirch the name of "Taiwu" and not betray the hopes placed in me by the people...
a858f2f2-3fcb-466e-ba6e-94fc9188f565/Opt.cn: ……只求不负这「太吾」之姓，不枉众人之所托……
a858f2f2-3fcb-466e-ba6e-94fc9188f565/Opt.ru: ..все, к чему я стремлюсь, - это не запятнать имя "Тайу" и не предать надежды, возлагаемые на меня народом...

a858f2f2-3fcb-466e-ba6e-94fc9188f565/Opt.en: ...if I may bring everyone a world of harmony where they can live and work in peace, then I shall wish for nothing more...
a858f2f2-3fcb-466e-ba6e-94fc9188f565/Opt.cn: ……若能使人人安居乐业，我便再无所求……
a858f2f2-3fcb-466e-ba6e-94fc9188f565/Opt.ru: ..если я смогу принести каждому мир гармонии, где они смогут жить и работать в мире, тогда я больше ничего не буду желать...

a858f2f2-3fcb-466e-ba6e-94fc9188f565/Opt.en: ...I only hope that Taiwu Village may ultimately become that eternally peaceful land of sanctuary in my heart...
a858f2f2-3fcb-466e-ba6e-94fc9188f565/Opt.cn: ……只盼这太吾村终能成为我心中那块永无纷争的和乐净土……
a858f2f2-3fcb-466e-ba6e-94fc9188f565/Opt.ru: ..Я только надеюсь, что Деревня Тайу в конечном счете станет той вечно мирной землей-убежищем в моем сердце...

a858f2f2-3fcb-466e-ba6e-94fc9188f565/Opt.en: ...taking the role of the local emperor might indeed be rather amusing...
a858f2f2-3fcb-466e-ba6e-94fc9188f565/Opt.cn: ……我便当一当这土皇帝，倒也十分有趣……
a858f2f2-3fcb-466e-ba6e-94fc9188f565/Opt.ru: ..взять на себя роль местного императора действительно могло бы быть довольно забавно...

a858f2f2-3fcb-466e-ba6e-94fc9188f565/Opt.en: ...if I can establish this place as my base and bring the entire world to kneel before me in submission...
a858f2f2-3fcb-466e-ba6e-94fc9188f565/Opt.cn: ……若能以此为基业，令世人向我俯首称臣……
a858f2f2-3fcb-466e-ba6e-94fc9188f565/Opt.ru: ..если я смогу сделать это место своей базой и заставить весь мир преклонить передо мной колени в знак покорности...

8ee4d182-cd67-4283-b73d-8f415c1730c2/Eve.en: The seagull flew astray, chasing the waves. Yet by a boulder it met its end, plunging deep in dark waters.<NL>I have no wings to soar high and above. Still I dare say this night stretches as long as the daylight!
8ee4d182-cd67-4283-b73d-8f415c1730c2/Eve.cn: 信鸥离巢逐浮浪，磐石断首落幽汤，<NL>我无凌云横插翼，敢笑此夜比天长！
8ee4d182-cd67-4283-b73d-8f415c1730c2/Eve.ru: Чайка сбилась с пути, гоняясь за волнами. И все же у валуна он встретил свой конец, погрузившись глубоко в темные воды.<NL>У меня нет крыльев, чтобы парить высоко-высоко. И все же я осмелюсь сказать, что эта ночь тянется так же долго, как и дневной свет!

32ff40e6-a767-4162-bacf-e8ef6ce28558/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> suddenly discovers,<NL>inside the bag, there is a set of clothes, perfectly tailored in size, color, and style, as if made just for <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderObject/>, making it impossible not to want to put them on immediately...Should he replace his current outfit with the gear from the travel bag?
32ff40e6-a767-4162-bacf-e8ef6ce28558/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>忽然发现，<NL>行囊内有一套衣物，无论规格、颜色、搭配式样，竟似为自己量身打造一般，<NL>令人忍不住想即刻换上……<NL><NL>是否要将<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>身上所着，替换成行囊里的装备？

32ff40e6-a767-4162-bacf-e8ef6ce28558/Opt.en: There are urgent matters, he'll arrange his attire later...
32ff40e6-a767-4162-bacf-e8ef6ce28558/Opt.cn: 身有要事，稍后再整理衣装……
32ff40e6-a767-4162-bacf-e8ef6ce28558/Opt.ru: Есть срочные дела, он позаботится о своем наряде позже...

2d7af8bb-ae0a-45d8-9c38-def34d0b77d2/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> heart stirs, and <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderSubject/> feels the martial arts techniques taught by the master flowing through <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderPossessive/> meridians, spreading throughout his limbs and bones, making him eager to try out the new moves...<NL><NL>Should <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderSubject/> replace her current martial arts with the inherited techniques?
2d7af8bb-ae0a-45d8-9c38-def34d0b77d2/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>心随意动，<NL>只觉高人所授功法，已依循经脉流转，传遍四肢百骸，<NL>令人忍不住想一试新招……<NL><NL>是否要将<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>身上武学，替换成继承而来的功法？

2d7af8bb-ae0a-45d8-9c38-def34d0b77d2/Opt.en: It's time to try practicing the techniques!
2d7af8bb-ae0a-45d8-9c38-def34d0b77d2/Opt.ru: Пришло время попробовать попрактиковаться в этих техниках!

2d7af8bb-ae0a-45d8-9c38-def34d0b77d2/Opt.en: There are urgent matters, he'll practice on his own later...
2d7af8bb-ae0a-45d8-9c38-def34d0b77d2/Opt.cn: 身有要事，稍后再自行演练……
2d7af8bb-ae0a-45d8-9c38-def34d0b77d2/Opt.ru: Есть срочные дела, позже он попрактикуется самостоятельно...

334d04f6-d71f-4b62-924c-748e971d9f5b/Eve.en: After thinking carefully, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> can't help but quietly recall,<NL>and practice the martial arts he learned before,<NL>but after a few moves, he realizes something strange:<NL><NL>the martial arts he's using and those of the master come from the same origin, at first glance, they seem identical,<NL>but when he performs the moves, the force, angle, and positioning are quite different...
334d04f6-d71f-4b62-924c-748e971d9f5b/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>左思右想，一时间情不自禁，<NL>将自己从前所学功法，也逐一在心中默默回忆演练，<NL>不料几招过去，已觉大有蹊跷：<NL><NL>自己与高人所使功法同出一源，初看毫无差别，<NL>可出招时的力道、方位、角度……竟迥然相异……

334d04f6-d71f-4b62-924c-748e971d9f5b/Opt.en: It seems to be a difference in personal understanding, making the techniques change and vary with each person's experience...
334d04f6-d71f-4b62-924c-748e971d9f5b/Opt.cn: 想来应是个人体悟不同，乃至招式施展千变万化……
334d04f6-d71f-4b62-924c-748e971d9f5b/Opt.ru: По-видимому, это разница в личном понимании, из-за чего методы меняются в зависимости от опыта каждого человека...

8eb09b87-e47b-471e-b5e3-928fd50549ff/Eve.en: Suddenly, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>'s thoughts shift:<NL>"Martial arts, in themselves, have no superiority or inferiority, their value is determined by personal cultivation.<NL>If I rush to achieve success now, it would be like pulling seedlings to help them grow, which is of no benefit to me...<NL>It's better to list all the martial arts I know, select a few, and when the opportunity arises, decide which ones to keep..."<NL><NL><color=#lightgrey>(Choose martial arts in the "Study" interface at any time.)</color>
8eb09b87-e47b-471e-b5e3-928fd50549ff/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>忽而心念微动：<NL>“功法招式，本无优劣，论及高下，但凭个人修为，<NL>若我此时急于求成，不啻揠苗助长，对己无益……<NL>不如将现今所知功法全数罗列出来，略为筛选，待机缘到时，再定去留也不迟……”<NL><NL><color=#lightgrey>（之后随时可在角色“修习”界面选择功法。）</color>

8eb09b87-e47b-471e-b5e3-928fd50549ff/Opt.en: Let me think this through carefully...

d62186d8-e2a0-4172-8a6f-497cc2763116/Eve.en: In the haze, it feels like the mountains are shaking and the earth is moving.<NL><NL>Suddenly, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> wakes up from <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderPossessive/> unconscious state, quickly opens <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderPossessive/> eyes,<NL>and sees that the "Extraordinary" is just a step away, about to shatter a wooden dummy into dust...
d62186d8-e2a0-4172-8a6f-497cc2763116/Eve.cn: 昏冥之中，好似山摇地动。<NL><NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />突然从昏迷中醒转，猛地睁开双眼，<NL>只见那“异人”只在咫尺之外，转眼便要将一具木人拆作齑粉……

d62186d8-e2a0-4172-8a6f-497cc2763116/Opt.ru: Бессмертный Сюй... (изо всех сил пытается встать...)

209f300c-cf7b-47ec-87bb-252486e275c3/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderSubject/> doesn't know if it's the sudden awakening from <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderPossessive/> trance that causes <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />'s senses to blur,<NL>but everything around him seems to become silent and intangible, except for the Fuyu Hilt that Immortal Xu is barely holding,<NL>trembling slightly in his hand...
209f300c-cf7b-47ec-87bb-252486e275c3/Eve.cn: 也不知是不是自昏迷当中猛地醒来，以致神智不清，<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />感觉，周遭的一切在此时此刻，都变得无声无息，虚无缥缈起来，<NL>唯有徐仙公勉强还抓在手中的伏虞剑柄在微微震颤不已……

209f300c-cf7b-47ec-87bb-252486e275c3/Opt.en: (Seek life in death by re-attaching the Fuyu Hilt...)
209f300c-cf7b-47ec-87bb-252486e275c3/Opt.ru: (Ищите жизнь в смерти, снова прикрепив Рукоять Фуюй...)

4b58ceaa-1335-4d9e-a2de-87dd794ee9f2/Eve.en: The spiritual Qi,<NL>in the sword comes from an unknown source to <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />, but it feels incredibly familiar, not at all foreign.<NL>It seems as if this power has been sealed in the sword hilt, waiting for this moment to return to <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />'s hand...

52de7e1f-8527-4416-8e54-1d8e45f1ab29/Eve.cn: 日月乍止，万物停歇，<NL>非但<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />呆愣未动，却连那“异人”也定在原地，犹如静止一般。<NL>静至极时，<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />眼前又浮现出一道朦胧却又熟悉的人影……

b739ca1c-1661-42f8-82f3-d2ef1428901b/Eve.en: The two Fuyu Hilts, one bright and one dark, touch, and the figure disappears in an instant.<NL><NL>Moments later, a huge spiritual Qi rushes into <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />, penetrating <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderPossessive/> organs!<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> feels <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderPossessive/> heart as if it's emerging from primordial chaos, attaining clarity and transcendence, entering a previously unknown realm...<NL><NL>Endless power pours out from the Fuyu Hilt...
b739ca1c-1661-42f8-82f3-d2ef1428901b/Eve.cn: 一明一暗，一虚一实的两支伏虞剑柄相触之时，那人影便在须臾间散去——<NL><NL>顷刻之后，一道巨大的灵气直冲<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />五脏六腑！<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />心中犹如鸿蒙初辟般清明超脱，遁入从前未知的境界……<NL><NL>无尽的力量自伏虞剑柄中涌出……

I hope you can end the suffering of the world..."

a4356a5b-c175-489a-bcfa-547bfac6f3f1/Eve.cn: 剑在手中，亦在心魂，<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />已有与那异人一较高下之力！

890dffae-1f0a-408f-b7a8-29cafece99cb/Eve.cn: “原来……是你……<NL>那剑我已舍身取回，你为何还不来拿？<NL>你定是仍在怪我鲁莽，也罢，我便用那剑将你杀了吧……”<NL>只见那“异人”话音未落，突然直扑向<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />！

52c9e2d7-133f-4c69-b39d-e24bc7ac4717/Eve.ru: Смертельно пораженный "Экстраординарным", <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> рухнул в лужу крови...<NL>И все же, видя, что <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> был на последнем издыхании,<NL>Вместо этого "Экстраординарный" медленно вздохнул...

In today's world, are there any saints?<NL>I cannot wait for a saint, I must go out and search...<NL>Let me see if you have the talent of a saint?"<NL>The "Extraordinary" says, and suddenly lunges toward <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />!

acb3da89-b0e6-41a0-8bbd-8043753569ce/Eve.en: The Hidden Rift is perilous, deep and bottomless,<NL>and once a person falls in, even if they don't shatter into pieces, they will die immediately...<NL><NL>The person, for some reason, abandoned life and death, entrusting these words...<NL>Though it is their first meeting,<NL>it feels as though they have known each other for a long time, and there is a bond of life-and-death friendship...
acb3da89-b0e6-41a0-8bbd-8043753569ce/Eve.cn: 暗渊天险，深不见底，<NL>常人一旦跌入其中，虽不至粉身碎骨，也要即刻殒命……<NL><NL>那人不知何故，竟舍却生死，倾付此言……<NL>二人虽是初见，却仿佛早已认识，结有“过命交情”……

700719f4-e54d-4d77-9bf5-c92aae20d701/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> tries to take the travel bag from the man and wait for him to climb out of the rift.<NL>But the man lets out a bitter smile, looking at <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> with respect, saying:<NL><NL>"If you have already made this choice... then this travel bag is nothing but a burden to you..."<NL><NL>At that moment, the person's expression hardens,<NL>he leans backward and plunges into the rift, the bag falling with him...
700719f4-e54d-4d77-9bf5-c92aae20d701/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>正欲接过对方行囊，再待此人自行攀爬上渊，<NL>却见其苦笑一声，望住<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>敬声道：<NL><NL>“若你已这般抉择……那这行囊于你，不过是负累牵绊罢了……”<NL><NL>就在这时，只见此人神情决绝，<NL>身向后仰，直坠下渊，连同那行囊也一同坠落……

7770045a-5c24-4251-97d2-5ad5da266fd6/Eve.en: <NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> seems to hear a voice in his ear, sorrowful:<NL>"How... how could you enter that abyss gate...<NL>This journey may temper your heart and sharpen your resolve, advance your deeds, yet how much suffering lies within it..."<NL><NL>The words carry deep respect; the person sighs and says no more...

a8401bdc-9195-46fb-aa75-4a4324f9c5b1/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> come around groggily,<NL>only to find that the person has already vanished without a trace,<NL>leaving behind nothing on the ground but a single note...
